profile.summary: Software Engineer with 15+ years of experience in full-stack web development, specializing in LAMP stack and modern JavaScript. Proven success leading large-scale systems like LIMS for clinical/genomic labs. Fast learner with a passion for scalable architecture and clean code.

positions.title: Independent Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Docker · Git · Front-End Development · AWS · Laravel · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Data Architecture · PHPUnit · Web Development · SQL · Next.js · PHP

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Own backend feature development and platform stability across a large-scale e-commerce system, resolving production issues and eliminating recurring PHP warnings.
- Designed a reusable PHP model architecture for internal livestreaming tools, reducing environment and event setup time from 8–10 hours to minutes.
- Led SEO and performance improvements including canonical tags, robots directives, caching strategies, and structured data, reducing crawler traffic by approximately 70%.
- Built and standardized Docker-based local development environments (WSL), significantly reducing onboarding friction and environment-related bugs.
- Refactored legacy procedural code into maintainable, testable object-oriented components.
- Applied AI-assisted tooling to accelerate refactoring, debugging, and test generation while maintaining production code standards.
positions.insights: Skills: PHP · MySQL · JavaScript · Laravel · Web Development

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Worked under Cerebrum but consulted for Quest Diagnostics on their laboratory information management system (LIMS). Managed, organized, and refactored legacy codebase into Laravel 9.
• Managed, organized, and refactored legacy codebase.
• Refactored codes to Laravel 9 architectures (Eloquent relations, API resources,  Factories, etc....)
• Convert raw SQL queries into Eloquent models.
• Enforce coding standards with Larastan and Pint, successfully got codebase to consistently passed coding errors and PSR standards at Larastan level 5.
• Implemented unit tests and testing guidelines and brought code coverage up to 80%.
• Performed code reviews, peer reviews, and were involved in project meetings to ensure project deliverables.
• Worked with and mentored co-workers and provided feedback to management to encourage team cohesion, and transparency.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Docker · Git · Front-End Development · AWS · Laravel · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Data Architecture · Unit Testing · Software Development · PHPUnit · SQL · Next.js · PHP

Gearfire is an innovative technology provider to the United States firearms industry. The company currently provides engaging eCommerce platforms to over 2100 firearm retailers. Consumers have the ability to search and make a purchase through our network of dealers’ websites. We offer consumers one of the world’s largest selection of firearms, accessories and gear available on the internet. We project consumer sales through our FFL Dealer network to exceed $75 Million by 2018. In addition, our system collects valuable real-time data that can be used by the firearms industry to understand consumer buying habits, trends, product market share, and a myriad of other relevant and actionable data. Lastly, Gearfire offers Manufacturers a consolidated means to push consistent advertising imagery and messaging across our entire network of dealers. Gearfire is a leader in offering multi-channel solutions to an industry that only recently started embracing technology - more specifically, eCommerce.

TAG Employer Services, an Administrative Services Organization (ASO), helps your business simplify, streamline, and accurately track payroll, HR administration, employee retirement and group health benefits, workers’ compensation, and other critical administrative activities.

No matter the size of your business – or the industry you are in – we will save you time and money with customized solutions tailored to your specific needs right now, and provide the resources and expertise that support you as you grow your business and enjoy greater success in the future.

Our proprietary web-based Software as a Service (SaaS) Human Resources Information System (HRIS) solutions elevate employee and employer self-service to a new level – with desktop, tablet, and smartphone accessibility. At the same time, we take just as much pride in our friendly, dependable customer support that is recognized as being second-to-none in our field.

Utilizing enhanced web technologies and cloud services, TAG supports clients across the US and Canada.
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Front-End Development · Data Architecture · Web Development · SQL · PHP

positions.title: CPHT Data Analyst
positions.description:
- Initiated a new reporting process that allows other PAC’s to actively monitor open cases and their due dates to avoid cases to go overdue using VB
- Created a MS Excel application in VB to calculate case due dates, reducing the reporting procedure from an hour long process to roughly 10-15 minutes
- Created a MS Windows application through VB that the process of running open cases reports through a user-friendly interface, eliminating tedious manual work
- Automated the reporting procedures, and familiarized other personnel  to produce a self-sustaining process that allows users with little to no prior technical skills to produce detailed reports and adhere to turnaround times
- Reduced the amount of overdue cases from, on average, of 26 cases, to 5 cases per year; significant reduction in costs in loss of contracts
positions.insights: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Data Architecture · SQL

positions.title: CPHT
positions.description:
- Analyze and fill prescriptions for patients
- Packed and shipped prescription drugs to patients in mail-order pharmacy
- Configure, operate, and refill medication dispensing machines

positions.title: CPHT
positions.description:
- Analyze worker's compensation prescription history to approve or disapprove early fills
- Ensure compound medication pricing was correct and up to date with average wholesale price database
- Responsible for coding prescription rejects to explore why prescriptions were denied by insurance companies.
- Explore patients' cases and analyze indications listed by doctors to ensure that the patients are able to get their medication as needed.
- Approve/disapprove whether or not prescriptions are able to be filled within a time frame.
- Was able to speed up the rejected prescription coding process from 1000 claims per month, to about 1000 claims processed per week.

positions.title: CPHT
positions.description:
- Intake written prescriptions and verify information from patients.
- Enter prescription into system and check against patient history and allergies for contradictions of therapies.
- Verify information with insurance and doctors for compliance.
- Fill and label prescription bottles to be verified by pharmacists.
- Process patient’s co-pays and fees.
- Intake phone calls for refills, or transfer to pharmacists for new prescriptions.
- Assist customers over the phone on due refills and ensure monthly customer satisfaction.
- Assist customers in over-the-counter product selections.
- Ensure proper pharmacy inventory.

positions.title: CPHT
positions.description:
- Analyze and fill prescriptions for patients.
- Work along-side pharmacists to troubleshoot and prevent dispensing errors.
- Packed and shipped prescription drugs to patients in mail-order pharmacy.

- Enter prescription into system and check against patient history and allergies for contradictions of therapies.
- Verify information with insurance and doctors for compliance.
- Fill and label prescription bottles to be verified by pharmacists.
- Process patient’s co-pays and fees.
- Intake phone calls for refills, or transfer to pharmacists for new prescriptions.
- Assist customers over the phone on due refills and ensure monthly customer satisfaction.
- Assist customers in over-the-counter product selections.
- Ensure proper pharmacy inventory.

experience.title: CPHT
experience.description:
- Analyze and fill prescriptions for patients.
- Work along-side pharmacists to troubleshoot and prevent dispensing errors.
- Packed and shipped prescription drugs to patients in mail-order pharmacy.
